newsitem.title: USA: PSE to list Allstate LEAPS on Dec 13.
newsitem.headline: PSE to list Allstate LEAPS on Dec 13.

text.p: The Pacific Stock Exchange (PSE) said Thursday it will list Allstate Corp LEAPS (long term equity anticipation securities) on December 13.
The exchange said the LEAPS, which are basically long term options, will have strike prices of 50, 60 and 70, with expirations in January 1998 and January 1999.
The insurer's stock was up 7/8 at 58-5/8 Thursday afternoon.
The PSE joins the Chicago Board Options Exchange and the American Stock Exchange in listing Allstate LEAPS. ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
